mapper.select: SELECT AUDIT_ID, EMP_ID, ACTION, DETAIL, ACT_EMP_ID, GLOBAL_TX_ID, ACT_DT FROM TB_EMP_AUDIT WHERE EMP_ID = #{empId} ORDER BY AUDIT_ID DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EMP_AUDIT (EMP_ID, ACTION, DETAIL, ACT_EMP_ID, GLOBAL_TX_ID, ACT_DT) VALUES (#{empId}, #{action}, #{detail}, #{actEmpId}, #{globalTxId}, #{actDt})
